context: You arrive at a Gur camp during a solemn ceremony — a pyre of armour, weapons and clothing is burning — where Ulma, leader of the Gur tribe, speaks to the player or to Astarion (who may be present as an avatar or companion). The Gur are a tribe of monster‑hunters who previously blamed the player/Astarion for stealing their children; they sent Gandrel (the Gur Hunter from Act 1) after you, and he may be standing nearby if he survived. Ulma, speaking with a marked accent, believes Astarion has broken the vampiric bond to his master and could be used to enter the vampire’s palace, lower its defences, and rescue the children. The exchange frames Astarion/player as either redeemable or a monster, and the player’s responses can range from agreeing to help to refusing or even attacking.
